# Auto Advant

AI/LLM project map for this repository.

## Overview

This repository is a dealership operations platform with a web frontend, a Node.js API, and shared packages.

- Frontend: Next.js + React + TypeScript at the repository root
- API: Express + Mongoose in `apps/api`
- Shared code: `packages/shared`

## What This App Does

- Staff management and role-based access
- Dashboard views for superadmin, dealer admin, branch admin, GRO, sales, security, and service roles
- Customer, enquiry, booking, vehicle, fleet, and reporting workflows
- Firebase authentication with backend session/profile lookup
- MongoDB-backed API models and controllers

## Important Paths

- `src/pages/` - main application pages
- `src/components/` - reusable UI and dashboard layouts
- `src/hooks/` - auth, dealer context, theme, and browser helpers
- `src/lib/` - API client, activity logger, role helpers, customer timeline helpers
- `apps/api/src/controllers/` - HTTP request handlers
- `apps/api/src/models/` - Mongoose schemas and models
- `apps/api/src/routes/` - API route wiring
- `apps/api/src/middleware/` - auth, scoping, and request guards
- `packages/shared/` - shared types and utilities

## Key Behaviors

- Auth is handled through Firebase client auth plus backend `/api/auth/me`
- Role-based UI and route access depend on the current role returned by the API
- Staff activity logging is centralized through the activity logger helpers
- Location and dealer scope matter for many queries and views
- Some pages use Next.js routing, while the API is a separate Express app

## Useful Commands

- `npm install` - install dependencies
- `npm run dev` - run the Next.js frontend
- `npm run dev:web` - run the Vite frontend variant
- `npm run dev:api` - run the API server
- `npm run build` - build the Next.js app
- `npm run lint` - lint the repository
- `npm run test` - run tests

## Editing Guidance For AI

- Prefer minimal, focused changes.
- Preserve existing role permissions and scoping rules.
- Do not replace Next.js pages with React Router implementations.
- When changing auth or role behavior, update both frontend guards and API authorization logic.
- Validate edited files after changes.

## Common Gotchas

- Some views look similar but are backed by different roles and scopes.
- Staff impersonation/switch-login should remain safe and reversible.
- Keep mobile and tablet layouts responsive when modifying dashboards and management screens.
- Do not assume a UI-only fix is enough if the backend authorization or data model is involved.

## Repository Notes

- Root README describes the monorepo structure and local ports.
- The API runs on port 4000 and the frontend on port 3000 in local development.
- This app includes several business dashboards, so changes should keep investor/demo clarity in mind.
